name: description
value: Choose the exam policy that applies to you. Your scores stay in place when you switch.

name: Attendance incentive
value: If you opted in and use no more than 4 flex absences, only your highest three of four exam scores count, at 20% each. You may skip the cumulative final or take it and let the lowest exam drop.

name: Final required
value: If you did not opt in, or you exceed 4 flex absences, all four exams count at 15% each and the cumulative final is required.

name: Other work
value: The Research and Writing Project is 20%, the Final Reflection is 10%, and Section Engagement is 10%.

name: Research participation
value: The five-hour research participation requirement does not add course points, but the department says an incomplete is assigned if it is not finished by the deadline.

name: Cutoffs
value: The course uses an absolute scale with A+ at 98, A at 93, A− at 90 and the remaining standard plus/minus cutoffs. No curve is applied.
